what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from South Africa in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2575 South African asylum seekers, and Ireland hosted 19.7% of them.
After Ireland, the largest hosts are Australia, Canada and South Korea.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for South Africa, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 98 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 4907, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
